name: CVLT-II list learning
what_the_model_does: Recall list words repeatedly, then recognize them.
changes_for_models: Written list stays visible; no delays.

source_files.license: public document; CVLT-II words are Pearson copyright

source_files.source: word-free list structure, categories, item types, and administration text

note: List A and List B words are read from the 48 recognition items of the public UCLA codebook and placed by the recognition positions in cvlt_structure.json. The words are never stored in this repository.
